test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means A is the daughter of B,

A - B means A is the wife of B'

A × B means ‘A is the brother of B,

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B'

Based on the above, how is P related to T if P + Q - R ÷ S × T'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Daughter
 Wife
 Brother
 Father
 
 

 

Given: P + Q - R ÷ S × T

It means: P is the Daughter of Q, Q is the Wife of R, R is the Father of S, S is the Brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9daf55f06b3a3a379627f939ebdb230cca63b093136800883448d3bd9b759b05.png] 

So, P is the 'Sister' of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
